POINT-IN-TIME DATA PROHIBITION (applies to ALL sections): - NEVER include file counts or statistics (e.g., "325 .cbl files") - NEVER include line numbers or line counts (e.g., "609 lines") - NEVER include specific program names unless critical configuration - NEVER include timestamps except in skip list entries - Focus on INTENT, PURPOSE, and PATTERNS, not current state

Keep it concise (aim for ~20 lines, but expand as needed for complex projects).
